description: This file defines serialization utilities, including functions for converting between strings and various data types, handling Unicode and ASCII conversions, and serialization of binary data (hex and Base64). It also includes a template class for parsing text fragments, likely used for configuration or data serialization within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing text fragments with support for quoting, whitespace, and line handling, used within serialization processes.

methods.name: ToCharacter
methods.description: Converts a character string to a TCHAR character array, handling Unicode and platform differences.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts various string types and character arrays to std::string or std::wstring, depending on Unicode settings.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Converts strings to numeric types (uint8_t, int8_t, uint16_t, etc.) using internal NumberType conversions.

methods.name: ToHexString
methods.description: Serializes binary data to a hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: FromHexString
methods.description: Deserializes a hexadecimal string back into binary data.

methods.name: ToString (Base64)
methods.description: Serializes binary data to a Base64 string.

methods.name: FromString (Base64)
methods.description: Deserializes a Base64 string into binary data.

methods.name: CodePointToUTF16
methods.description: Converts a Unicode code point to UTF-16 low and high parts.

methods.name: UTF16ToCodePoint
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 low and high parts back to a Unicode code point.

methods.name: ToCodePoint
methods.description: Extracts a Unicode code point from a UTF-8 or UTF-16 encoded string.

methods.name: FromCodePoint
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode code point into UTF-8 or UTF-16.

methods.name: ToQuotedString
methods.description: Returns a string with quotes added around the input string.
